title: Earth+: On-Board Satellite Imagery Compression Leveraging Historical Earth Observations
problem: Satellite downlink capacity is so limited that over 90% of captured earth-observation images are never downloaded; existing on-board compression techniques treat each image independently and cannot exploit the rich temporal and spatial redundancy available across an entire satellite constellation.
motivation: Earth-observation satellites generate far more imagery than can be transmitted to ground stations, creating a critical bottleneck that wastes the majority of sensor data; cross-constellation reference images would dramatically improve compression ratios but require a new system architecture.
method: Earth+ implements a change-detection-based compression pipeline on the satellite. Ground stations upload recently captured reference images from other satellites in the same constellation to each on-board satellite via the uplink. On-board processing compares each newly captured image against the latest matching reference image and transmits only the changed regions (delta encoding). The system manages reference image currency and on-board storage to ensure that references are temporally close to the captured images, maximizing delta sparsity and thus compression.
key_novelty: First system to use cross-constellation reference images uploaded from ground stations to enable inter-satellite temporal redundancy exploitation for on-board compression, reducing downlink usage 3.3x over state-of-the-art without sacrificing image quality.
contributions: Cross-constellation reference image upload architecture that keeps on-board references current using data from sibling satellites.
Change-detection-based on-board delta compression pipeline operating within satellite compute and storage constraints.
3.3x reduction in downlink usage compared to state-of-the-art on-board compression without quality loss.
First demonstration of constellation-wide imagery sharing to improve per-satellite compression ratios.

metrics.speedup: 3.3x reduction in downlink usage vs. state-of-the-art on-board compression without quality loss or extra resource consumption

baselines: state-of-the-art on-board satellite image compression techniques
limitations: Not discussed; assumes reliable uplink to push reference images from ground, which may not hold under adverse communication windows.
primary_theme: Cross-constellation reference-based on-board satellite imagery compression
